# tidyverse author - package edgelist from

```{r}
vct_packages <- c("dplyr", "ggplot2", "ellmer",
                        "tidyr", "tidymodels", "recipes",
                        "readr", "tibble", "stringr", "forcats",
                        "purrr", "lubridate")

# data cleaning
package_author_edgelist <- 
  as_tibble(tools::CRAN_package_db()) |>
  filter(Package %in% vct_packages) |>
  mutate(Author = str_replace_all(Author, ' \\[|\\]', "*" )) |>
  select(Package, Author) |>
  mutate(Author = map(Author, ~ str_split_1(.x,"\n"))) |>
  unnest() |> 
  mutate(Author = Author |> str_remove('\\*.+' )) |>
  mutate(Author = Author |> str_trim()) |>
  filter_out(Author |> str_detect("orcid.org")) |>
  filter_out(Author == "Posit Software, PBC") |>
  filter_out(Author == "Posit, PBC")

head(package_author_edgelist)
```


#  `ggraph_to_threejs` first cut


Notes: Some reasons why the function isn't totally robust or satisfying...

- it is not easy to extract the edgelist from the ggplot object made by ggraph, therefore both the ggplot2 object and the edgelist are required.
- the node layer is assumed to be the 2nd layer, and the visual attributes are extracted via `layer_data(i = 2, plot = plot)`
- an additional aes node_id should be used if the label is not the same as the node name - this helps join the input edgelist to the visual attributes of the ggplot2 nodes for use in 3JS.





```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggraph)
library(igraph)
library(threejs)
library(tidygraph)

ggraph_to_threejs <- function(edgelist = package_author_edgelist, 
                              plot = last_plot()){
    
  g <-  edgelist |> select(1:2) |> as.matrix() |> 
    graph_from_edgelist()
  
  node_data <- layer_data(i = 2, plot = plot)
  
  graph_attr(g, "layout") <- NULL    
    
  node_id <- V(g) |> names()
  
  joined <- tibble(node_id) |> 
    left_join(node_data, by = "node_id")
  
  from_list <- edgelist |> pull(1)
  
  V(g)$size <- joined$size/3.66
  V(g)$shape <- joined$label
  V(g)$color <- joined$colour
   
  graphjs(g = g, bg = "gray10",  
          showLabels = T,  
          layout = list(  
            layout_with_fr(g, dim = 3)),  
                    main = "")

}

my_edgelist <- tribble(~v1,~v2,
        "A","B",
        "A","C",
        "A","D",
        "B","C")

my_edgelist |>
  ggraph(layout = "kk") +
  geom_edge_link() + 
  geom_node_label(aes(
    node_id = name, # just for threejs
    label = name, 
    color = name == "A"))
  

my_edgelist |>
  ggraph_to_threejs(plot = last_plot()) #< the three js versions..
```





```{r, echo = T}
theme_set(theme_gray())

tv_tidygraph <- package_author_edgelist |> 
  tidygraph::as_tbl_graph() |>
  mutate(is_package = name %in% vct_packages)

tv_tidygraph |> 
  ggraph(layout = "kk") +
  geom_edge_link() +
  geom_node_label(aes(label = name, 
                      node_id = name, # for conversion to threejs
                      color = is_package))
```


```{r}
library(threejs)
library(igraph)

package_author_edgelist |> 
  ggraph_to_threejs(plot = last_plot())
```

```{r, eval = T, echo = T}
tv_tidygraph |> 
  ggraph(layout = "kk") +
  geom_edge_link() + 
  geom_node_text(aes(
    node_id = name, # just for threejs
    label = is_package |> ifelse("📦", "🧠"), 
    color = is_package |> ifelse("tan", "pink") |> I()))
  

ggraph_to_threejs(package_author_edgelist)


tv_tidygraph |> 
  ggraph(layout = "kk") +
  geom_edge_link() + 
  geom_node_text(aes(
    size = !is_package,
    node_id = name, # just for threejs
    label = is_package |> ifelse("📦", "🏃🏽"), 
    color = is_package |> ifelse("tan", "tan") |> I())) + 
  scale_size(range = c(3,8))

ggraph_to_threejs(package_author_edgelist)
```
